channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Ice arenas are energy hogs. Ramsey County is doing something about it.
item.description: Maplewood’s Aldrich Arena used as much electricity as 60 average U.S. homes last year. Solar panels and other improvements are expected to help.

item.title: AI use explodes on Minnesota college, university campuses
item.description: Artificial intelligence has gone mainstream this semester, three years after the debut of ChatGPT. Schools and professors are scrambling to respond.

item.title: 10 Minnesota supper clubs that set the standard for classic dining
item.description: Popovers, prime rib, relish trays, grasshoppers and nostalgia — you’ll want to gas up the car before reading.

item.title: ‘You have to earn the right to stay’: P.J. Fleck reflects on Gophers tenure ahead of Rate Bowl matchup with New Mexico
item.description: The football coach, who was hired in 2017, will wrap up his ninth season with the program on Dec. 26 at Chase Field in Phoenix.

item.title: What were the top 10 Minnesota albums of 2025?
item.description: She’s Green, Samia, Gully Boys and Alan Sparhawk were among the local acts offering adventurous listens this year.

item.title: The elusive, enduring power of Minnesota supper clubs
item.description: They’re known for prime rib dinners and popovers, but what exactly makes a restaurant a supper club? “It’s not just one thing.”

item.title: Snoop Dogg scores with unlikely collaborators during Vikings halftime show
item.description: The rapper was joined by Andrea Bocelli, Lainey Wilson and dozens of musicians.

item.title: Takeaways: Defensive masterpiece lifts the Vikings to their fourth win in a row
item.description: The Vikings get little production from quarterback Max Brosmer but force six turnovers in a 23-10 win over the Detroit Lions.
